name: Grupo Rotoplas S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Grupo Rotoplas S.A.B. de C.V., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, purchases, sells, and installs plastic containers and accessories for storage, conduction, and improvement solutions in Mexico, Argentina, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Individual Solutions and Comprehensive Solutions segments. The company offers storage solutions, water tanks, cisterns, rural rainwater harvesting, urban rainwater harvesting, rotoplas fittings, accessories, water conditioning device, tampons, rainwater harvesting system, and tank accessories.
